_about: DRAFT scene geometry, normalised [0, 1] coordinates of the reference frame (C3896.MP4, middle frame). Other sessions are shifted by up to ~3% of the width: warp with src/registration.py before use. Directions are [dx, dy] in pixel-aspect space (x right, y down). Derived from reference frames + EDA (outputs/eda), not from camera.md, which was not provided.
_signals: Gantry heads over avenue_near face away from the camera. avenue_far keeps moving (~70%) while the visible heads are red: its phase is separate and not visible.
_unsure: Stop line for avenue_far not visible. The carriageway is built from moving-vehicle anchors (tools/build_carriageway.py); kerbside parking at x < 0.1, y 0.30-0.55 is excluded. The right extent of the intersection is a guess. Solid lane dividers before the stop line not yet drawn. Between the refuge island and x = 0.90 below the far crossing no lane is set: U-turns, inbound and outbound traffic share that area.
